statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations
The patient has a history of sick sinus syndrome
The patient had a recent episode of transient cerebral ischemic attack
CPT 93271 (prolonged cardiac rhythm monitoring) was billed
The diagnosis codes G45.9, I49.5, and R00.2 were submitted
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
Prolonged cardiac rhythm monitoring is indicated to evaluate for potential embolic sources such as paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The service is medically necessary to detect intermittent arrhythmias responsible for the transient cerebral ischemic attack and palpitations
